datasheet: TI CSD13202Q2 SLPS313A (Jan 2018, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/csd13202q2.pdf; local scratchpad/study-1-2s/dl/ds/csd13202q2.pdf): pinout p1 'Top View' (D = 1, 2, 5, 6 + pad 8, G = 3, S = 4 + pad 7), package p8 (7.1, pad 8 1 x 0.95, pad 7 0.75 x 0.3), 7.1.1 Recommended PCB Pattern p9 (NSMD, mask 0.05 max all around), 7.1.2 Recommended Stencil Pattern p10
derivation: Merged-drain land (DESIGN-SPEC 4.3, EQ): pad 8 copper = the TI pad 8 (1.00 x 0.95 at y -0.325) widened to the pin toes (x +-1.20), so it joins drain pins 1, 2, 5, 6 (same y span -0.80..+0.15); copper only, the solder-mask openings stay the TI lands (pins 1:1 + 1.00 x 0.95 aperture), so solder wets only the TI land. 8 phase vias 0.35/0.20 (D6, Type VII) as PTH heatsink pads numbered 8: 2 x 2 at the 0.40 minimum pitch centred in pad 8, plus one centred in each drain pin pad 1, 2, 5, 6. Paste per the TI stencil (pad 8 0.90 x 0.86, pad 7 0.70 x 0.29, pins 1:1).
exposed_note: auto-detected (>= 0.5 mm2): the 8 via pads share number 8 with the drain land and must not count as exposed pads
